def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    open_prices = [150, 152, 153, 151, 152, 150, 149, 151, 150, 148, 147, 146, 148, 149, 147]
    close_prices = [152, 150, 152, 153, 151, 152, 150, 149, 151, 150, 149, 148, 146, 147, 148]
    period = 14

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    gains = []
    losses = []

    for opening, closing in zip(open_prices, close_prices):
        if closing > opening:
            gains.append(closing - opening)
            losses.append(0)
        else:
            gains.append(0)
            losses.append(opening - closing)

    sum_gains = sum(gains[-period:])
    sum_losses = sum(losses[-period:])
    imi = (sum_gains / (sum_gains + sum_losses)) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(imi, 2)
